_about: Every word the page shows that is not the story (story.json) or a gun, enemy or upgrade's own name (their files). {placeholders} are filled by the core or the page.
title: Long Time Comin'
subtitle: You were sent back to stop yourself. They sent you fifty years early.
holding_text: A bench, a lamp, and the clerk who counts your Clemency. Spend it on what the court allows.
no_counts: No count has been read yet.
map_hint: Tab or M to close. The bright line is the main path; side paths are harder and end in the reward shown.
abandon_confirm: Abandon: it counts as a death
hint_arrival: WASD move · Space jump · Shift dash through orbs · hold Left Mouse to fire · walk into the glowing gate
hint_fight: Big orbs hurt. Jump the rings that run along the ground. Dash makes you untouchable for a moment.
hint_cleared: Cleared. Blue gates follow the main path; orange gates take a harder side path to its reward.
hint_rest: The water heals you fully. The Court of Hours lies beyond.
callout_recess: RECESS: THE BLOW IS STRUCK FROM THE RECORD
no_webgl: This browser has no WebGL 2, which the game needs to draw.
credit: Made by Sam Gilson. Art drawn in TikZ.
save_note: Your record is kept in this browser.
